lines: d37: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Violet Sandoval is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d37: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d37: 🕯️ Violet Sandoval is dead — the arena. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d37: What Violet kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d37: "Violet's gone." Ellie looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Violet." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d37: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Elif blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d37: 📖 LEARNED: Scrounger (Level 1). Ruin looting finds +1 item.
d37: 📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
d37: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d37: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d37: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d37: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Violet Sandoval, 37 days. The mantle passes to Elif Demir.
d37: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Elif Demir, 45 — a hotel housekeeper. Her hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, Echo Location, Berserker Rage.
d37: The village's quarrel was with Violet — and Violet is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d37: At the grave, Ellie, Ivy speak for Elif — "Violet trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d37: The fire knew Elif before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.
